# iOS

* Bundle ID `com.dslink.emulator`, iOS 16+, arm64. Project generated by XcodeGen from `ios/project.yml`
  (`cd ios && xcodegen generate`, then open `DSLink.xcodeproj`).
* `Info.plist` has `NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription` ("DSLink deve trovare gli altri giocatori sulla tua rete locale."),
  `NSBonjourServices = [_dslink._tcp]`, `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`. If the permission is denied the Join screen shows
  "Accesso alla rete locale disattivato" + *Apri Impostazioni*.
* Signing: nothing is configured. In Xcode select your Team (Signing & Capabilities) – that is the single step needed to run it on an
  iPhone. CI builds with `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO` and publishes an **unsigned** `.app` zip (not an installable IPA).

## Emulator integration status — NOT DONE

The iOS app contains the complete DSLink layer (identity, system-file import, discovery, handshake, link test, launch
configuration) but **RetroArch + melonDS DS are not yet linked into it**: *Gioca / Avvia gioco / Continua* prepare the
configuration and then report that the engine is not connected. Remaining work: build `melondsds_libretro` for iOS
(`-DPLATFORM=OS64 -DDEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14`, upstream-supported), embed it in RetroArch's iOS project
(`pkg/apple/RetroArch_iOS13.xcodeproj`), add the iOS equivalent of patch 0001 (netplay args from the app), and present
DSLink's SwiftUI screens before RetroArch's. Also note: melonDS' JIT is unavailable on non-jailbroken iOS without a JIT
enabler (e.g. AltStore/SideStore), so performance may be insufficient on older devices – unmeasured.
